summaries.en: free-for-dev is a curated GitHub repository that solves the challenge of discovering genuinely useful free-tier cloud services for developers and DevOps teams. Its core approach treats video manipulation as a programmable pipeline: a coding agent interprets natural language instructions or scripts to perform cuts, transitions, effects, and overlays. Users can batch-process tutorials, generate personalized clips, or embed video editing into AI workflows by defining rules and letting the agent execute the edits.

summaries.en: lingbot-map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data, enabling real-time 3D understanding from video or sensor streams. Unlike traditional SLAM or offline reconstruction, its feed-forward architecture processes data in a single pass, avoiding iterative optimization for speed and robustness. This makes it ideal for applications like autonomous navigation, robotic manipulation, or AR/VR where low-latency scene understanding is critical. You can integrate it into a perception pipeline by feeding camera or LiDAR streams and obtain dense 3D reconstructions directly.

summary_short.zh: claude-video 使 Claude 模型能够“观看”视频，弥补动态视觉内容与静态文本理解的鸿沟。它下载视频后提取代表性帧，通过 Whisper 转录语音，再将视觉与音频上下文一并交给 Claude 推理。技术上将时域视频转化为适合 Claude 上下文窗口的多模态提示，采用帧采样与转写而非实时处理。输入 `/watch [链接]` 即可分析课程录像、总结会议或审查内容。适合需要 AI 视频理解而无须定制管线的团队。

summaries.en: Claude-video enables Anthropic’s Claude model to “watch” videos by bridging dynamic visual content and static text understanding. It downloads a video, extracts representative frames, transcribes speech via Whisper, and sends both visual and audio context to Claude for reasoning. Technically, it converts temporal video data into a multimodal prompt within Claude’s context window using frame sampling and transcription rather than real-time processing. Users can analyze lecture recordings, summarize meeting videos, or moderate content by running `/watch [URL or file]` to receive insights. This tool suits teams needing AI video understanding without custom pipelines.
